votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2022-23
votes.description: The Board voted to close the public hearing regarding the resolution to amend the RDA's final budget for FY 2022-23, which included additional funding for the Marmalade Plaza Project and property acquisition in the Depot District.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of Tuesday, October 12, 2021
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from its October 12, 2021 meeting.

votes.motion: Approve $1M in additional funding to complete Marmalade Plaza in West Capitol Hill Project Area ($720,000 from Revolving Loan Fund, and $280,000 from Arctic Court infill housing budget)
votes.description: The Board approved $1 million in additional funding to complete the Marmalade Plaza project, drawing from the Revolving Loan Fund and the Arctic Court infill housing budget.

votes.motion: Approve $3.9M to purchase Station Center property in Depot District Project Area, thus adopting Resolution 10 of 2022, amending the final budget of The Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City for FY 22-23
votes.description: The Board adopted Resolution 10 of 2022, approving $3.9 million to purchase parcels in Station Center within the Depot District Project Area and formally amending the RDA's FY 2022-23 budget.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 11 of 2022, authorizing the $4 million seller's note for the Spark development, located at 1500 West North Temple
votes.description: The Board adopted Resolution 11 of 2022, authorizing a $4 million seller's note at 1.25% interest over a 30-year term for the Spark mixed-use affordable housing project at 1500 West North Temple.
